items.title: 68239_Ram Ramirez oral history interview
items.q: Coleman Hawkins just gave me some money there, man.

ctx.x: the Brown Brothers took me, and there on the bandstand was Fletcher Henderson. Who else was there... Well, they had two bandstands at the Savoy. But when they played, I was so taken, man! I was so astounded at the way these musicians played. They had Walter Johnson on the drums, you know, Coleman Hawkins and... Yeah, that was the set-up there. Oh, what a great band that was. Whoo! Bobby Stark... And then, when Rex Stewart starts screaming on the trumpet, you know, I thought he was a fantastic... I thought he was…
